usedFor: Imgur holds your posts, and Slack gets a message when “New Comment” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Comment” in Imgur, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A comment on your Imgur post shows up in Slack, so you see it without checking Imgur.

watchOut: “New Comment” in Imgur is polling, and a Slack channel post from an automation waits for your approval today.
